segments.he: ובהקדמת התיקונים איתא בנים מארי קבלה וכו', ובהקדמת מהרנ"ש לפרע"ח כתב כי מי שלא למד התורה עפ"י סוד אעפ"י שהשלים עבודתו בתכלית השלימות הוא רק בבחי' עבד וכו' אבל מי שלומד ועובד השי"ת בפנימיות החכמה בנסתרות התורה ועושה יחודים הוא בבחי' בן וכו'.
segments.en: And it is also explained from Rabbainu's words regarding the singular Tzaddikim of the generations — that before the Tzaddik descends to this world, it is possible to be an upright G-d-fearing person even without that Tzaddik and his Torah. But from when he comes into this world, it is not possible at all to merit without him and without his Torah what one needs to merit. And from his holy words it appears that this flows from the ways of Hashem in the management of the world — "this opposite that" — and that in the descent of the Tzaddik who is the healer of souls into this world, with precious and wondrous medicines and bandages not yet revealed in the world and that nothing can stand against them except through the segulos and medicines of the Tzaddik that were newly created and came down corresponding to them in these times. One who does not heal himself with them — his hope is lost, Heaven forbid. Until here his words.
